Even if the checksum were 'SKIP' (which it is not), that would not affect the safety of this step, as source fetching is not performed during `--printsrcinfo`.

Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of unintended code execution or data exfiltration.
</details>

The package() function correctly installs the built binary into the appropriate directory. All operations are confined to the build directory and standard cargo tooling. There are no signs of obfuscated commands, unauthorized data exfiltration, or malicious side-channel activities. The use of `cargo-nightly` in makedepends is expected given the nightly toolchain requirement.
</details>
